summary.goal: Spawn and manage agents via Relay SDK for task execution. Workers produce artifacts, auditors verify them. Agents are short-lived: spawn -> work -> exit.

acceptance_criteria.description: spawnWorker(taskId, cli, workspacePath, mcpConfigPath) creates agent via relay.spawn()
Agent name pattern: run-{runId}-task-{taskId}
Receive agent messages via relay subscription (progress, completion, blocked)
Detect agent exit (normal completion or crash)
Handle agent timeout with graceful termination (SIGTERM -> wait -> SIGKILL)
Support multiple CLI providers: claude (default), codex, gemini, ollama
Agent receives MCP config for Forge tools at spawn time
Agent prompt includes task context from .forge/context.json

observations: Relay SDK spawn() returns handle for agent lifecycle
spawn -> work -> exit pattern: agents are task-scoped, not persistent
MCP context injected at spawn time via --mcp-config flag
Multiple providers via CLI abstraction in relay
Workspace context file provides full task info to agent
patterns: Spawn with working directory set to worktree path

steps.title: Create AgentSpawner interface
steps.description: Define interface for agent spawning abstraction

acceptance_criteria.description: AgentSpawner interface: spawn(config), terminate(agentId), getStatus(agentId), listActiveAgents()
SpawnConfig type: { taskId, runId, cli, workspacePath, mcpConfigPath, timeout, contextFile }
SpawnResult type: { agentId, pid, spawned_at }
AgentStatus type: { agentId, status: 'running' | 'completed' | 'failed' | 'terminated', exit_code?, last_heartbeat? }

specification.pattern_description: Copy Spawner interface pattern from planner-core. See lines 46-50.

steps.title: Implement RelayAgentSpawner
steps.description: AgentSpawner implementation using Relay SDK spawn()

acceptance_criteria.description: spawn() calls relay.spawn() with agent name pattern: run-{runId}-task-{taskId}
Working directory set to workspacePath
MCP config injected via --mcp-config flag pointing to .forge/mcp-config.json
terminate() sends SIGTERM, waits 5s, then SIGKILL if needed
listActiveAgents() returns list of currently running agent IDs via relay API

specification.pattern_description: Copy spawn implementation pattern, adapt for task-scoped agents

steps.title: Implement agent message subscription
steps.description: Subscribe to agent messages via relay for status updates

acceptance_criteria.description: subscribeToAgent(agentId, callback) registers message handler
Callback receives parsed agent messages (progress, completion, blocked)
Unsubscribe on agent termination
Message types mapped to trajectory events

specification.pattern_description: Use relay client message subscription pattern

steps.title: Implement agent exit detection
steps.description: Detect when agent process exits (normal or crash)

acceptance_criteria.description: onAgentExit(agentId, callback) registers exit handler
Callback receives exit_code, signal, and duration
Exit triggers task status update (check if report_complete was called)
Exit without report_complete: mark task 'failed' with AgentCrashError including exit_code and last message

architecture.pattern: Process exit event from relay spawn handle
architecture.failure_detection: Check task.status - if still 'running' after exit, it crashed
architecture.error_message: Agent exited unexpectedly (exit_code={code}, signal={signal}). Last message: {lastMessage}

steps.title: Implement agent timeout handling
steps.description: Gracefully terminate agents that exceed timeout

acceptance_criteria.description: Configurable timeout per task (default 30 minutes)
Timer started on spawn, cancelled on exit
On timeout: SIGTERM -> wait 5s -> SIGKILL
Timeout triggers task 'failed' state with AgentTimeoutError: 'Agent timed out after {duration}'

steps.title: Support multiple CLI providers
steps.description: Allow different CLI providers for agents (claude, codex, gemini, ollama)

acceptance_criteria.description: CLI provider configurable per task (default: claude)
CLI command built based on provider (claude vs ollama run)
Provider-specific flags handled (--mcp-config for claude)
Validation that provider is in supported list - throws UnsupportedCLIError if not

architecture.cli_builders: Map of provider -> command builder function

steps.title: Inject task context into agent prompt
steps.description: Build agent prompt with task context from workspace files

acceptance_criteria.description: Read .forge/context.json from workspace for task details
Build prompt including: task description, acceptance criteria, available MCP tools
Include instructions for using report_progress and report_complete tools
Prompt template configurable per project

steps.title: Wire up queue worker callback with error propagation
steps.description: Provide onTaskReady callback to task queue that spawns agents, with proper error handling

acceptance_criteria.description: createAgentSpawnCallback(spawner, storage, workspaceManager) returns queue callback
Callback: loads task from storage, creates workspace, spawns agent
Updates task.status to 'running' and task.agent_id after spawn
Workspace creation failure (WorkspaceError) caught and task transitions to 'failed' with error details visible in task.error field
Spawn failure (AgentSpawnError) caught and task transitions to 'failed' with error details
No silent retries - failures are immediately visible in task status

architecture.integration: This callback is passed to forge-task-queue createQueueWorker()
architecture.sequence: dequeue -> load task -> create workspace -> spawn agent -> update status
architecture.error_handling: Catch workspace/spawn errors, update task to 'failed' with task.error = error.message
